raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_customers passes raw_customers.region through unchanged, so 218 customers carry numeric region codes 01-04 instead of names. raw_region_map supplies exactly those four codes (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so a join to it resolves the alert and leaves already-named regions unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
